question: Does allocation-wide containment retain useful precision when the registered screening workload is expanded, and how do unpromised fixed-catalog reuse and explicitly recalibrated expanded-catalog controls compare?
population: Exact original primary calibration and test maps in each domain; no southern run, no new population, no subset chosen by outcomes.

queries.original: Every frozen3mile distinct crossing mask retained.
queries.rationale: Halve and double the existing screening radius at the same facility centers; a limited scale-change test, not newly claimed regulatory/exposure thresholds.
queries.centers: All center IDs that alias any original3mile registered mask on that map; reuse exact retained coordinates.
queries.construction: WGS84 geodesic distance<=radius*1609.344. Deduplicate masks within and across all three radii; alias provenance retained.
queries.selection: Crossing at least one positive-known-total source, exactly the original eligibility rule; zero-width/identical masks counted as construction controls, not extra weighted queries.
queries.main_estimand: Joint coverage of the unique union of original and added masks per original test map; original queries ensure every map remains represented. Width, interval score and useful/saturated fractions average queries within map then maps.
queries.secondary: Added-mask-only summaries and separate1.5/6mile summaries; report eligible map counts and do not treat queries as independent.

methods.frozen: Original primary predictor, training IDs, covariance rho/ell, spatial bandwidth/scale-training rule and calibrated radii. No retuning to test coverage. Reconstruct spatial training scores only for original3mile masks; no new training selection.
methods.expanded_rule: Same original calibration maps and nominalalpha.1; rank of max normalized residual over union workload; spatial scale remains original frozen scale. This explicitly changes declared catalog and its calibration residual summaries, not test fitting.
methods.not_included: Label-free and point references already establish separate issues; no new label search, predictor search or redundant identical transportLP row.
methods.information_budget: Same known margins, coordinates, covariates and original fine calibration vectors for every method. Fixedcatalog reuse has no new-query guarantee. Expanded controls explicitly use expanded-calibration answers; no allocation method is credited with a unique future-query capability.

metrics.coverage: Originalcatalog,newmask-only and union joint coverage by map; query coverage diagnostic only; wholemap event from frozen recorded scores.
metrics.precision: Macro width/coarsewidth, alpha.1intervalscore, usefulness<.95 and saturation>=.999999. Preserve poor/adverse results.
metrics.uncertainty: Numerator/denominator and paired map changes describe this finite frame; no iid/external confidence claim. Geometry-only query additions are prespecified on already inspected maps, not untouched-population confirmation.
metrics.cost: Shared frame loading/querymaskconstruction/geometry and frozenmodel reconstruction; test per-method constructor and endpoint time separated; expanded calibration score and threshold costs separate; original calibration sunk costs referenced, not silently counted free. Singlehostobservations, no speedup or deployment claim.

validation: Original3mile endpoint rows must reproduce archived rows for fixed methods; covered allocation implies unioncatalogcovered. First10addedmasks/domain in sortedmap+mask order checked scan and box againstLP, conic residual/gap checks for all. Independent record arithmetic. New-mask generation geometry-only; no outcome-dependent failures skipped.
limits: Exploratory prespecified workload reanalysis on already inspected populations. No test outcome selection, causal attribution, matchedtruecoverage superiority, newdomain count or deployment guarantee.
